messages.en: Finally... the day has come.[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: The time, the people, the place...[br]All is now here before us...[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Across the long ages...[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Our wish shall now[br]become reality!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Now...[br]With our magic, let us seize[br]the power of that chaos![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: If even one of us loses focus,[br]our lives will be...[br]swallowed by the darkness!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: O King of Chaos and Darkness...[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: O god who governs the powers of evil...[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Now is the time to awaken[br]from your long slumber[br]and come before us.........[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Here and now...[br]the legendary powers of[br]Blue, Green and Crimson[br]become TRINEA......[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: By that power of revival,[br]answer our wish![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Is it you?[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: You foolish ones...[br]who call me forth[br]from my long ages of sleep......[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: In the name of the Dark King[br]of Chaos who governs TRINEA...[br]we swear the ancient Oath, here and now!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Ha ha ha......[br]Very well! What is your desire?[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Grant us the power[br]to conquer every living thing[br]in all the world!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Ha ha ha!![br]Such a trifle is all you want?[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Then so be it...[br]Your wish has been heard!![br]Ha ha ha......[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Grant us the power[br]to conquer every living thing[br]in all the world...............?![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Hornisse:[br]Hold it![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Sara:[br]I won't let you do that![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Ryo:[br]That is far enough![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Graf:[br]Who's there?[br]Hm? Oh, it's only you.[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Hornisse:[br]Graf! What is the meaning of this?[br]I demand an explanation!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Sara:[br]Graf...[br]What on earth is going on here?![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Ryo:[br]Graf![br]What is the meaning of this?[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Graf:[br]Can't you see for yourself?[br]What's before you is all there is![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: What's that look for?[br]You still don't understand?![br]Then allow me to explain......[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Everything you've done[br]was nothing more than...[br]helping the Dark King return![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: O Dark King, Penta Dragon......[br]Here stand fools who would[br]stand in the way of our Oath!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: We offer up their lives to you now![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Hornisse:[br]I see! So this is what[br]Forfahren was afraid of![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Sara:[br]You weren't stopping the revival...[br]you were bringing it about![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Ryo:[br]You slew Forfahren[br]and deceived me, did you not?![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Ha ha ha......[br]To think you would defy me...[br]What utter fools......[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Learn the depth of your folly.[br]Be swallowed by terror...[br]and rot away before us!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Hornisse:[br]Hmph![br]I won't fall after coming this far!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Sara:[br]What are you trying to do?![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Ryo:[br]What was that?! Bring it on!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Graf:[br]You aided the revival yourselves.[br]Don't hold it against me...[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Hornisse:[br]Lisa...[br]There's one last thing I must say...[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Sara:[br]Funny, what comes back at a time like this...[br]Something Lillie told me long ago.[ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: Ryo:[br]Midori......[br]I shall see this through!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: If I make it home alive......[br]I mean to name our child[br]"Sara"![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: That my father was a legendary hero.[br]So his blood flows in me too......[br]I can't lose here![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: No matter what.........[br]I will come back to you alive.[br]I promise! Wait for me!![ENDK]

messages.note: entry = 00 id param text... FF (83=newline). Located by linear scan ($CE:49A7), no pointers.
messages.en: And so the Oath is fulfilled.[br]Darkness, terror and suffering[br]upon the world!! Kneel before me![ENDK]
